intervention: Boundary closed-program typed catalogue reachability after full admission and before final admission; no Agent policy or World evaluator change.

method.comparison: Optimized BPC1, unpruned successor and pruned successor rotate over three process observations per lane/format in each of two windows. All three original fixture lanes and their assertions remain.
method.unit: Cumulative fresh guest milliseconds per complete fixture scenario, not whole-user latency or request p99.
method.clock: Same original instrumentation and complete expected-failure denominator as inquiry-performance.json. Native/Wasmtime verification and fixture tool handling lie outside the guest interval.
method.memory: Native Session workspace requested-payload peak; excludes input-file decoding and host/output buffers, and is neither RSS nor total WebAssembly memory.
method.isolation: Frozen producer sources and immutable runtime inputs. Task-owned builds finished before timing. Diagnostic builds and normal-pin requalification run afterward.
method.qualification: The public Agent compiler re-emits repair/repeated/ReAct images. Task/outcome schemas match exactly. Each complete measured fixture matches the original semantic/work-count projection. This development probe is separate from final normal-pin consumer qualification.

reachability.method: Read-only diagnostic using the same relocation reference sites; corroborates catalogue removal but is not an independent semantic oracle.

observations.method: Three rotating observations per lane/format/window, two windows. Only compiled catalogue closure differs between current variants; the World kernel, native tools and Agent policies are identical. Original guest interval and semantic assertions are retained.

reproduction.priorHarness: Use the authenticated sources, build-tools, instrument, semantic projection and fixture policies retained in inquiry-performance.json. Build the unchanged Agent inquiry emitter against boundaryAfter and replace only the three BPI3 images. Retain identical schema bytes and runtime/native/inspector tools for both successor variants.

limits: No speedup is inferred from image or catalogue size alone.
Normal dependency/package qualification is a separate gate.
Primary-workload peak and latency regressions against optimized BPC1 remain liabilities unless the paired results actually resolve them.

preparationDiagnostic.scope: Diagnostic immutable Boundary snapshot with phase/capacity prints and final-facts root traversal; retained byte accounting excludes allocator metadata. No production implementation change or compaction gain is claimed.
